name: data-storytelling
tagline_zh: 当老板盯着报表皱眉，你用图表讲出故事。把枯燥数字变成有情节的叙事，让汇报不再被追问。
tagline_en: Turn dry spreadsheets into stories that stick. Make your next data report a narrative your boss actually remembers.
desc_en: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.
why_zh: 不止画图表，它自动搭叙事结构，用可视化+上下文+说服逻辑，让数据自己开口说话。
why_en: Not just charts—it structures your data into a persuasive narrative with context and visuals, so insights speak for themselves.
